summary: PASS_NO_CODE_CHANGE - 现有GoalRegistry / Goal State与Observation反馈链已经满足B31 Goal Progress / Completion Evaluation要求，无需建立新的Goal Progress Engine。GoalRegistry.UpdateStatus自带RWMutex原子保护，GoalStatus包含终态(achieved/abandoned)和非终态(pending/active/suspended/wish)，Progress字段(0-1)支持进度追踪。无需创建GoalProgressEngine2等新系统。
